stories.title: Ewloe church hall to be demolished after asbestos found
stories.summary: A church hall next to the Church of the Holy Spirit in Ewloe is set to be demolished after asbestos was found throughout the building. stories.title: Police praise police dog Arlo after he was bitten on duty
stories.summary: Police dog Arlo was bitten while helping Wrexham officers detain a suspect over the weekend. North Wales Police said the suspect had been evading officers for much of the afternoon before Arlo helped bring the arrest to an end. The force said Arlo was able to carry on despite being bitten. stories.title: Cllr Marion Bateman becomes latest Flintshire councillor to join Reform
stories.summary: Cllr Marion Bateman has announced she is joining Reform UK. She has represented Northop on Flintshire County Council since 2009, sitting as a non-aligned councillor. stories.title: Full list: Flintshire road closures and traffic lights for the week ahead
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has published its roadworks bulletin for the week of 4 to 11 September. It lists 17 full road closures and 25 sets of temporary traffic lights across the county. Some of the works run well beyond this week, into October, November and, in one case, March 2027. stories.title: Fudge Kitchen opens first new shop in almost a decade in Chester
stories.summary: Fudge Kitchen has opened a new shop at 6-8 Watergate Street in Chester. It is the company’s first new shop opening in almost ten years.
